sn35.126:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nāḷandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane.
sn35.126:1.2: atha kho upāli gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho upāli gahapati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.126:1.3: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme no paribanibbāyanti.
sn35.126:1.4: ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme parinibbāyantīti
sn35.126:1.6: ayaṃ kho gahapati hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme parinibbāyantīti.
